text:
3. 3. 4

Suddhakasuttaṃ

1202. Sāvatthiyaṃ:

Cattāro me bhikkhave, satipaṭṭhānā. Katame cattāro: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Citte cittānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Ime kho bhikkhave, cattāro satipaṭṭhānāti.
